scope: First substantive/application-document pass for Geertruidenberg, Geldrop-Mierlo, Gemert-Bakel, Gennep and Gilze en Rijen using the 52-municipality standard.

substantiveRules: Policy applies to building/kadastral splitting into independent dwellings; kamerverhuur/hospitaverhuur remain outside this policy and are governed by the (temporary) Omgevingsplan.
Splitting limited to urban residential area; new-build first 10 years excluded; business-estate dwellings excluded; outside urban area provincial rules apply.
Each post-split dwelling minimum 50 m2 GBO.

Independent access to public road/shared entrance, current parking policy, acceptable urban/environmental living climate, Bbl compliance, spatial quality, heritage checks and omgevingsdialoog required.
records.applicationRoute: Apply via Omgevingsloket; concept application/municipal consultation recommended where uncertain.
applicationEvidence: Policy requires an omgevingsdialoog and final participation report.
Practical splitting page highlights parking, access/utilities, waste and external-space arrangements as permit-relevant considerations.
records.fees: Current product refers to current Legesverordening; exact fee not encoded until tariff line is matched.

verified: Current Beleidsregel bijwoning met zelfstandige voorzieningen Gemert-Bakel is in force from 16-04-2026 and explicitly states that this route must not concern woningsplitsing or perceelsplitsing.

Bijwoning generally requires ETFAL, compliance with other law, a licensed principal dwelling and exclusion of business parks/recreation parks/woonwagen locations; size 30-100 m2 and lifecycle-resistant design are core conditions in the policy branches.
Current Bibob policy lists commercial room rental/pensions and labour-migrant accommodation as risk categories.
records.quality: Bijwoning is kept separate from ordinary woningsplitsing/kamerverhuur; it is not misused as the generic splitting rule.
